rule: A deployed version passes when, for each case, its answer carries the same facts as tool_output.

cases.question: Someone asks which store feedback stages are recorded as complete and whether sentiment, theme grouping or recommendations come next. Use the StoreFeedbackAnalyzer tool on the sample.
cases.tool_output:
{
  "completed": [
    "Collect feedback"
  ],
  "external_work_performed": false,
  "next_stage": "Detect sentiment",
  "scope": "Design-only checklist; no sentiment or themes are inferred.",
  "stages": [
    "Collect feedback",
    "Detect sentiment",
    "Group themes",
    "Recommend actions"
  ],
  "store": "Contoso sample shop"
}
cases.local_answer:
For the Contoso sample shop, only **Collect feedback** is recorded as complete.

**Next up is Detect sentiment.** Theme grouping and recommendations come after it, in this order:
1. Detect sentiment (next)
2. Group themes
3. Recommend actions

The tool reports this is a design-only checklist, so no sentiment, themes, or recommendations have been produced yet.
